goal: Build a small persistent local job queue product that survives restart and supports safe idempotent enqueue, deterministic claiming, acknowledgement, failure and bounded retry.
why_selected: Higher information value than another isolated algorithm: requires multi-module interaction, durable state, restart semantics, idempotency, edge cases, unit tests and integration tests while remaining safe and offline.

contract.required_verifier: independent code review after all objectives PASS

objectives.goal: Define immutable Job value object and durable JsonJobStore with atomic-ish replace semantics and JSON round-trip.
acceptance_criteria: state is one of READY, CLAIMED, DONE, FAILED
missing store file loads as empty
malformed JSON fails loudly without overwriting original data

objectives.goal: Implement PersistentJobQueue over JsonJobStore with idempotent enqueue, deterministic claim, ack, fail and bounded retry.
acceptance_criteria: enqueue of same id+payload is idempotent
enqueue of same id with different payload is rejected
claim returns oldest READY job deterministically
fail increments attempts and returns READY until max_attempts then FAILED

objectives.goal: Prove restart-safe end-to-end behavior across process-like reconstruction of store and queue.
acceptance_criteria: enqueue then reconstruct queue from disk preserves READY job
claim then reconstruct preserves CLAIMED state
DONE job is never claimable after restart
integration scenario contains at least one edge-case assertion not duplicated from unit tests

restartability.requirement: A fresh Director turn must be able to choose the next READY objective using this file plus GitHub CI/review evidence only.
restartability.last_checkpoint_reason: Prepared while V1 round-3 verifier was pending; no V2 code may start until V1 is PROVEN.
